args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

@gideon.sato Draft Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team (from #inc-vtg-hartford, times as logged in that room, Aug 3):

Vantorre Hartford gate kiosks went offline. Both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan, so gate check-in was down. Scheduling still worked from the dispatch office. Carrowmere Cloud was checking the Hartford gateway route.

- First report: 10:42 AM, gate kiosks offline, both inbound lanes affected.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM, trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.

Open item: the status page was not visible to Mateo's account (separate access issue, still being chased). Tracked under INC-4821. Kiosk 2 was kept powered on for reconnect attempts.

Note: the incident channel is still open for another arrival cycle.

I posted the draft in #strategic-random as a reply to you. Nadia and Ruth can also see it, since they're in that channel. It has only operational facts from #inc-vtg-hartford, so no approval was needed.

- First report: 10:42 AM, gate kiosks offline, both inbound lanes showing a white screen.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM, trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.

The draft also notes that Mateo's account can't see the status page (tracked under INC-4821) and that the incident room stays open for another arrival cycle. The times are as logged in the incident room on Aug 3. I haven't sent anything to Mateo or his procurement team.
